primary: attempts-to-first-adoption (quality), recorded wallMs (cost proxy), attempts per round (parallelism)

passGate.insufficientEvidenceVerdict: insufficient evidence at pass-gate size — thresholds not evaluated
passGate.source: self-improve/rrsi-protocol.json p2 (this file does not re-derive them)

epochRule.boundary: editable-surface digest; an adoption is the observable boundary event, ledger-only chore commits are not
epochRule.baseCommit: provenance only, never the epoch key
epochRule.crossEpochReplay: disallowed (a later epoch becomes available only after the adoption that opened it was played)
epochRule.historyRule: attempts recorded before a replayed slice are ex-ante prior knowledge: branch hypothesis novelty, prior revealed outcomes and prior guard-failure classes may use them

revealProtocol.selection: ex-ante features only; an attempt's outcome is revealed after it is selected
allowedFeatures: prior revealed outcomes of the same branch or objective

policies.B0: recorded order, batch 1, stop at first adoption
policies.B1: fixed round-robin objective order, batch 1, stop at first adoption
policies.piStar: selected by dreaming on the TRAIN split only from the deterministic candidate space
policies.candidateSpace: 5 order rules (fixed, round_robin, success_greedy, failure_greedy, novelty_first) x batch size 1-3 x stall switch x stop rule = 40 candidates by construction (<=48)

betas.note: the paper-shaped replay value V = s - beta1*N + beta2*N/max(1,k) is reported for reference; ranking uses the primary metrics above

costProxyCaveat: the cost proxy is load-dependent recorded wallMs, not a fresh measurement
noStatisticalSignificance: All P2 comparisons are off-policy replays over ONE realized corpus of fewer than ~24 recorded attempts; no statistical significance is claimed; effect sizes are reported with n and are not confidence-interval estimates of future performance; the cost proxy is load-dependent recorded wallMs, not a fresh measurement.
noPostHocEdits: No post-hoc threshold edits: thresholds are unchanged from the original replay-protocol.json and are frozen again by this file's commit before the P2b dream/replay run.

corpus.passGateSituation: attemptsAtFreeze (22) >= passGate.n (20); the validation slice (last 6 attempts) includes 3 adoption cycles, so the frozen thresholds will be evaluated.
corpus.splitDisclosure: train = attempts 1-14; validation = attempts 17-22; attempts 15-16 are excluded from the train/validation slices and used only in the full-corpus anti-fluke score.
corpus.integrity: the protocol file hash and the 22-attempt corpus hash are recorded in the P2b evidence receipts before and after the dream/replay runs; the original replay-protocol.json remains unchanged.

evidence: this protocol file plus its commit hash
the deployed policy artifact and current.json
the seed used for the dream run
supersedes: replay-protocol.json (v0.0.6 13-attempt corpus; preserved unchanged as historical evidence)
frozenReason: JJO-213 follow-up: the accumulated ledger reached 22 attempts, meeting the original passGate.n=20 without changing thresholds. This is a new pre-registration after the original 13-attempt run, not a retroactive edit of the original P2 verdict.
